notes.title: Update 1.015 Live (fixed small issues and added options + HUD improve)
notes.content:
-HUD now has shadows for easier reading & better look

-Fixed a few tile graphical errors

-Added a few bomb-blocks to level 1-2 to introduce players to the mechanic earlier

-Screenshot bug fixed where only F12 would work

-Added window/fullscreen option to menu


As always,  thanks for playing, and have fun! ːsquirrel_orangeː
